Hair, fingers, boots and sword tip are completely inside the final alpha bounds; empty margins are left=180, top=50, right=257, bottom=57 pixels.
No visible green or magenta outline remains in the final white/dark diagnostic view; no obvious color holes in face, clothing or equipment.
The flame core remains orange-red; neutral gray outer wisps and the reduction of broad soft glow are retained as a chroma extraction limitation.
No stone floor, smoke-cloud background, cast shadow, UI, companion, Orbs or Sovereign Blade remains in the body texture.
First green-key result and first magenta alpha pass are preserved as unselected history.
